chapters.title: The old model and why it broke
What each partner type should do now

takeaways: In FY26 Microsoft consolidates six solution areas into three: AI Business Solutions, Cloud and AI Platforms, and Security.
Designations and especially advanced specializations gate co-sell visibility and the largest incentive programs, so partners must sequence them deliberately.

Start by checking your Partner Capability Score in Partner Center, anchor on your strongest area, set up attribution such as partner admin link and CPOR, and align your messaging to the new solution areas.
hook: Microsoft's FY26 partner restructuring changes how partners are evaluated, funded and surfaced to field sellers, and many are still on the old playbook. This episode is for Microsoft partners, MSPs, ISVs and distributors, and it explains the new solution areas, designations and incentives plus a sequencing strategy to protect co-sell access and funding.
